title: SwitchingSchedule
description: Supplemental attribute naming the time series that schedules the open or closed state of the switches it is attached to. Schedule values: 1 = closed, 0 = open.

status_schedule.description: Name of the time series, stored on this attribute, that carries the switch status schedule.

identifier.description: Optional user-supplied identifier for the schedule, such as a name or a switching plan id. Null when not set.
